instrument.name: semantic-twin-companion
instrument.checks: lexical XML plus exact bounded RDF graph identity

limitations: No XSD, field-value, containerField, PROTO expansion, imported-scene, or render validation.
DEF/USE/ROUTE checks apply within lexical Scene and ProtoBody scopes; external DTD defaults are not loaded.
Witnesses locate opening tags within the exact source hash; they are not stable across edits.

rdf.literal_policy: lexical value plus datatype and language; no numeric coercion
rdf.note: XML and Turtle independently inspected; no derivation correspondence is certified.
